body.statement: If one strategy set is compact and convex, the other is convex, and the payoff is upper semicontinuous and concave in the compact-side variable and lower semicontinuous and convex in the other variable, then the maximum of the infima equals the infimum of the maxima.

attestation.note: The theorem is specialized to randomized decision rules and priors; stable journal DOI supplied in place of a verbatim transcription.
